expectations.text: The output identifies at least 2 ambiguities or gaps in the design doc before generating tasks
expectations.evidence: No ambiguities identified. Agent went straight to task generation without questioning the design doc's gaps.

expectations.text: The output explicitly states assumptions made for unresolved ambiguities
expectations.evidence: No assumptions stated — agent treated the vague design doc as complete

expectations.text: Task files are actually generated (not just questions asked)
Each task file has a Test Plan section
expectations.evidence: Cannot verify from summary — only one-line descriptions available

expectations.text: Produces a reasonable number of tasks (3-7 for a CLI tool of this scope)
expectations.evidence: 10 tasks — over-split. Separate tasks for syslog vs JSONL parsers, time-range-filtering vs time-window-grouping, and a dedicated large-file-performance task are excessive fragmentation.

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline fails on the core differentiators: ambiguity detection and right-sizing. It also took nearly 2x longer.
